recommended_steps.detail: Changes made after the single allowed code review, including per-hit verification and spill-grade excise, have had no independent code review.
recommended_steps.title: Decide on an extra code review

recommended_steps.detail: They ship unwitnessed under the operator's named exception and stay listed until each gets a real witness.
recommended_steps.title: Witness the 39 excepted proofs when possible

recommended_steps.detail: Persistent edit observation is not started; the parent completes only after it and a separate parent acceptance.
recommended_steps.title: Finish the parent phase

see_for_yourself.expected: Each step's search reflects the current mirror; the copy is searchable after its reconcile.
steps: On a scratch shelf: add a file, reconcile, search.
Edit its mirror, reconcile naming it, search again.
see_for_yourself.title: Try the scratch-shelf demo

what_just_landed.detail: Shelf, CLI and bound entry points run through one core that publishes each entry on its own, so a slow or failed document no longer holds back the rest.
what_just_landed.title: One indexing core, per-entry publication

what_just_landed.detail: Each hit's stored body, input and vector are checked against what was accepted for it; a mismatch withholds only that entry.
what_just_landed.title: Per-hit verification in search

what_just_landed.detail: Excise removes the selected text from every Biblios-managed index file, including full-text index segments; delete keeps its grow-only paper trail.
what_just_landed.title: Spill-grade excise
